name: Activate Firmware Update Mode
summary: Adversaries may activate firmware update mode on devices to prevent expected response functions from engaging in reaction to an emergency or process malfunction. For example, devices such as protection relays may have an operation mode designed for firmware installation. This mode may halt process monitoring and related functions to allow new firmware to be loaded. A device left in update mode may be placed in an inactive holding state if no…

strategies.name: Detection of Activate Firmware Update Mode

analytics.name: Analytic 1934
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol message sequence placing a field device into firmware-update mode from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, correlated with the device's alarm telemetry going silent within a short grace period without acknowledgment. Documented precedent: Industroyer exploited CVE-2015-5374 by sending a crafted packet that initiated an incomplete firmware update sequence on Siemens Protection Technology (SIPROTEC) relays. analytics.name: Analytic 2158
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a firmware update tool on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux engineering host initiating firmware-update mode activation outside a scheduled maintenance window, by a User Identifier (UID) not in the approved firmware manager UIDs.
